newsitem.title: USA: Montgomery Ward names Searles merchandising head.
newsitem.headline: Montgomery Ward names Searles merchandising head.

text.p: Montgomery Ward & Co Inc said Tuesday it named executive vice president Michael Searles as president of Montgomery Ward merchandising.
Searles, 47, a former chief executive of Toys R Us Inc's Kids R Us, will manage Ward's merchandising and marketing activities, the retailer said.

"This move is part of our long-term plan for Montgomery Ward," said Bernard Brennan, chairman and chief executive of Ward. "As I stated several weeks ago, we have a search underway for a new CEO, and we maintain our objective of hiring an experienced executive for the company. Mike will provide that person with a strong merchandising partner to help grow our company."
Searles joined Montgomery Ward in May. He had been executive vice president, Apparel and Gold 'N Gems for the retailer.
